name: Algolaser Alpha MK2
tagline: Premium open-frame diode focused on speed and fine engraving detail
tldr: Algolaser targets makers who want faster engraving and tighter spot control than typical budget diodes. The Alpha MK2 competes with Sculpfun and xTool D1 Pro on performance. Price sits above Ortur but below xTool on many configs.
mainObjective: Fast, detailed open-frame engraving for makers who outgrow entry-level diodes

engraveExample.description: Filled photo or logo on birch plywood

cutExample.description: Simple square cut-out from 3 mm basswood

pros: Tight spot for finer detail in diode class
Fast fill engraving on optimized settings
cons: 40W optical claims need verification on your unit
Premium price vs Ortur for similar watt class
beginnerNotes: Choose Alpha MK2 over Ortur if engraving speed and fine detail matter more than saving $150. Skip if you need enclosure: look at Acmer P3 or xTool S1.
proTips: Algolaser shines on line art and shallow fills: push speed on vectors after test burns. Use compressed spot advantage for photo engraving on coated wood.
primaryUse: Performance-oriented open-frame diode for detailed wood and leather engraving with above-average speed.
